verses.1: And when all the kings who lived beyond the Jordan, in the mountains and on the plains, and in all the open areas of the great sea, heard of this, they came to meet him. They included the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivvites, and the Jebusites.
verses.2: And they gathered together to fight against Jehosua and Israel there, together.
verses.3: And the people of Gibeah heard about what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
verses.4: And they also did this in the wilderness. They went out, gathered up sacks filled with dried herbs for their meals, and also dried fruits, nuts, and other provisions.
verses.5: And their shoes were torn and their feet were covered with dirt. Their clothes were also dirty, and all their bread was rotten.
verses.6: And they went to Joshua at the camp. They said to him, “We come from a distant land. Now, please make a covenant with us.”
verses.7: And the man of Israel said to God, “I, in my own person, am the one who sits here. How then can I make a covenant with you?”
verses.8: And they said to Joshua, “Our servants are we.” But Joshua asked them, “Who are you, and from where do you come?”
verses.9: And they said to him, “From a distant land have come your servants to worship your God. We have heard what he has done in Egypt.”
verses.10: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, who lived beyond the Jordan, towards Sihon, king of the Amorites, and to Og, king of the Bashan.
verses.11: And they said to us, “Our ancestors and all those who live in our land, say: Take a stick in your hands and go ahead. Then you can call upon them. And you will say to them, ‘Your servants, we do this now.’”
verses.12: This is our suffering; it has been prepared for us from the day we set out to go to you. Now, behold, it has come to pass, and we will be united together.
verses.13: And these are the wounds of the sword that have been inflicted upon us. Now, they have healed, and our shoes and clothes are no longer worn out from walking too much.
verses.14: And they took the men away from them, and they did not ask for the mouth of Jehovah.
verses.15: And Joshua made them happy. He made a covenant with them for their lives. And the leaders of the people accepted this covenant.
verses.16: And after three days, they heard that they were approaching. And when they arrived, they sat down with him.
verses.17: And the children of Israel went forth and arrived at their cities on the third day. Their cities were located in the wilderness, in the desert, and in the forests.
verses.18: And the Israelites did not cry out, because their leaders were obedient to God, the God of Israel. And all the elders agreed that the leaders should be punished.
verses.19: And all the rulers said to the whole assembly, “We have sworn an oath to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. Now we cannot do anything against them.”
verses.20: This shall be done for them. May God live with them, and may there not be any wrath upon us for having accepted their offerings.
verses.21: And the rulers said to them, “May they live as trees that bear fruit and as those who bring water for all the people, just as the rulers have spoken to them.”
verses.22: And Joshua called to them and said, “Why do you deceive us by saying that we are far away from you? We are actually very close to you. And yet, you live among us.”
verses.23: And now, you will be like slaves who are not recognized among you. You will be like woodcutters and those who carry water to the house of God.
verses.24: And they answered Joshua, saying, “It has been reported to your servants that Jehovah your God commanded Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of that land from before you. We are very afraid of you, and we will do as you say.”
verses.25: And now, we are in your hands. What is good and right in your eyes, do it for us.
verses.26: And he did so. He rescued them from the hands of the children of Israel, and they were not killed.
verses.27: And Joshua gave them those things on that day: wood for fuel and water for offering to Jehovah, until that day comes when they will be taken to the place where they are to be sacrificed.
